reviews.t: Extremely disappointed! The mirror was great for its very short ...
reviews.x: Extremely disappointed!  The mirror was great for its very short lifespan. Received this product on 5/19/16 and on 6/25/16 the touch switch became unresponsive. No longer have the ability to use the different brightness settings and to turn off the light, must remove the batteries.

I got this for my wife, and she loved it (at first).  The touch switch for the lighting is a nice feature, and it's handy that it can be used either as a plug-in or with batteries. ADDENDUM:  About two months after purchase, and after being used only about six times, this product failed.  The light quit working, and then the mirror came off of the stand because the flimsy plastic threads on one of the pivot points were stripped.  An impressive looking mirror, but apparently made with shoddy mate

reviews.t: Plug started leaking fluid within a month of use and ruined my makeup desk!!
reviews.x: I just had this product delivered a little over a month ago, and when I went to use it today I saw there was liquid below the plug. I went to wipe it and it wiped away layers of my desk!! I then reached up to touch the plug for this mirror and it was leaking! It must be some type of acid to eat away at a desk. So not only do I have a $60 mirror that doesn't work in about a month, but I can't return it...and it ruined a new desk I just recently purchased!!

The mirror appears to be excellent quality upon receipt.  The build is very sturdy, the touch light is a very nice feature as well as having 3 different shades of light.  One thing I want to caution,  which is not related to the product quality is the magnification.  I have never bought one of these types of mirrors before and I bought it for my wife who really likes it, but in my opinion 10x maybe a little too much magnification.  I think 5x or 7x would be good.  Again, the mirror is very nice,

reviews.t: The magnification is good but the design and quality are very poor
reviews.x: The magnification is good but the design and quality are very poor.  Suppose to be Oil Rubbed Bronze and it is almost black with a crudely painted gold line at the base.  That is not Oil Rubbed Bronze.  Mirror design and quality are not acceptable and will be returning.

I love this mirror. The first one I ordered stopped turning off a few days after I had received it. I had to take the batteries out to turn it off. I called Ovente customer service, they sent out a replacement mirror. The company stands behind their products. Its a beautiful mirror.

reviews.t: The magnification is the best I've found in 30 years
reviews.x: The magnification is the best I've found in 30 years!  The lights are accurate and make applying makeup a breeze whether for day, night, or home.  The touch light works great changing from the 3 different light ranges.

Loved it...for about three weeks.  Then the light touch-sensor stopped working and the only way to turn it off is to take the batteries out.  I noticed that several other Buyers have had the exact same problems with this mirror, so I would recommend AGAINST purchasing it - it seems like there is a defect in the manufacturing.  BUT EVEN WORSE - it is stated that there is  one year limited warranty on this mirror through the manufacturer - however, after 30 days the Seller will not accept returns.

Nicely bright without being overbearing. Clear optics and nice size overall. The base is a bit light weight, so it could tip over and break, but we can change that. The auto off feature is handy. We are buying another.

I CANNOT BELIEVE I BOUGHT THIS 1 MONTH AGO NOW THE LIGHT DOES NOT WORK!!!! I THREW THE BOX OUT AND NOW AMAZON SAYS I CANNOT RETURN!!! VERY UNHAPPY WITH AMAZON! NO WAY TO GET IN TOUCH THAT I KNOW OF!! LASTED ONLY 1 MONTH! I Finally got in touch with Amazon and they are going to help me but still disappointed with this product only lasting 1 month!  I read another person now who had the same problem!

This is the best mirror I've ever owned. It's plenty bright with 3 adjustable light settings. The mirror is plenty large and you can plug it in or use batteries. The 10X magnification definitely makes it easy to pluck eyebrow and to apply makeup.

I apply my makeup in a very poorly lit room, so I need a mirror with lighting that is similar to outdoors. This mirror has three different light settings, all of which are helpful depending on where you plan on being that day. The magnified side shows you everything you may or may not want to see. As others have mentioned, you have to look into the middle of the magnified side as the edges have a warped reflection, but that is a minor issue seeing as how you will be fairly close anyway. I gave this two stars in previous review because I thought the switch stopped working. However, I figured out it was the batteries. I used it 6 times and the batteries failed! Thank god you can also plug it in. Otherwise, a nice mirror. Good height and large enough to see your whole face. 3 different light options is nice too.

reviews.t: Garbage.  Stopped working 5 months after purchase.
reviews.x: Garbage.  It looks cool and the fact that it can be used without a cord is unique.  Ultimately, though, this is just disposable garbage. Less than 5 months after buying it, the light quit working.  Isn't that the whole point of a lighted mirror.  Initial reviews are meaningless if the item doesn't hold up to even minimal use.  Don't waste your money or time with this.
I am changing my review, I bought this mirror less than a year ago, it work great untill it fell apart.

Love the mirror. The oiled bronze finish matches our bathroom fixtures. The on-off "button" responds well and we really like the choice of three tones of lighting. These are plenty bright enough.  I especially like the fact that it is battery operated, so there is no cord trailing across the counter. The 10x magnification is excellent for applying makeup.

My wife just loves it, she like the three different light settings so she can choose brighter lite if needed.  the size and magnification were perfect, the style was very good and the versatility of being able to use 110 or battery is great especially when we go out in our RV

reviews.t: The mirror I was looking for!
reviews.x: I took a chance and bought the refurbished item, 8.5" silver. I've had it about 6 weeks, and I absolutely love it! It's bright enough to do my makeup in my bedroom. The 10x side is a little much, and I'd prefer 5x, but I use it anyway for tweezing, etc. The regular side is clear and distortion-free. I love that you can plug this one in, unlike most of the other LED mirrors, so I don't have to deal with batteries. It does have the option to use batteries, though, so you can walk around with i

This mirror has a "normal" side and flips to 10x magnification.  The normal side is somewhat less than the actual size of one's face so it is not particularly useful, although the lighting is very bright and has three different levels.  The flip side is so huge it's actually somewhat scary:  every pore, every blemish, every imperfection screams "fix me, fix me!"  After the initial shock wears off, it is apparent that this mirror does just what it should do and does it well.  I wo

reviews.t: This mirror has nice features but it poorly manufactured
reviews.x: Very poorly designed product.  Nut and screw comes loose inside of mirror causing mirror to displace from stand and lighting to fail.  Opened mirror and replaced nut and screw but mirror  broke again after two weeks of moderate use. Tried new batteries and tried using only the direct connection but mirror and lighting still failed.  This mirror has nice features but it poorly manufactured.  Purchased the mirror in August 2016 and it broke by November 2016.

Don’t buy this.  I’ve had 2 of these in the past few months. The first one got to me, and the light wouldn’t come on at all. I ordered a replacement, thinking it was a defect, and within 3 months of having the replacement, the light is dimmed to the point where it’s useless. I only use this mirror a few times a week - I’ve probably used it 40 times total, max. At this point, it’s too late to return it, so I’m stuck with it.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the touch switch or light failing within weeks to a couple of months of use, often requiring battery removal to turn it off.
Reviewers praise the three adjustable light settings and brightness for makeup application.
The 10x magnification is widely praised as strong and helpful for makeup and eyebrow plucking.
Some reviewers report poor build or finish quality, including a misrepresented color and a leaking plug that damaged a desk.
Several reviewers note the convenience of using the mirror either plugged in or with batteries, though battery life is short.

qa.q: Is the 10X magnification too strong for full-face makeup?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say the 10X magnification makes applying makeup easy [1][2], while others find it too strong, with one calling it "a little too much" [4] and another describing the magnified side as "somewhat scary" showing every pore and blemish [3].

claims.text: The 10X magnification makes it easy to pluck eyebrows and apply makeup.
The magnification makes applying makeup a breeze.
In one reviewer's opinion, 10x may be a little too much.
The magnified side is so huge it's somewhat scary, showing every pore and blemish.

qa.q: Does the mirror feel sturdy or wobbly when spinning?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: How bright are the LED lights and can you adjust them?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the lights as "nicely bright without being overbearing" [1] and "plenty bright" [5], and some mention adjustable settings: "3 adjustable light settings" [5] and "three different light settings so she can choose brighter lite if needed" [6]. However, other reviews report the light failing or dimming to uselessness [3][4], and one notes brightness diminishes over time per the manufacturer [2].

claims.text: The lights are described as nicely bright without being overbearing.
The mirror is described as plenty bright with 3 adjustable light settings.
A reviewer likes the three different light settings to choose brighter light if needed.
Some reviewers report the light not working or dimming to uselessness.
One review notes LED brightness diminishes over time per the manufacturer.

qa.q: Does the auto shut-off timer actually work well?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it worth the price compared to cheaper vanity mirrors?
qa.answer: One reviewer explicitly says it is worth the money [4], and others praise its brightness, three light settings, and magnification [2][6]. However, reviews do not directly compare it to cheaper vanity mirrors, so no direct price comparison can be made.

Reviewers praise its brightness, three light settings, and magnification.
